description: Publish one reply on X now from the creator's connected X account, replying to in_reply_to (an X post id or status URL). Show the user the exact text and get their approval first. The server enforces safety caps (30 replies/day, 6/hour, 4 min spacing, 2 per author/day, <=10% links, no near-duplicates over 7 days) and writes an audit entry. Returns the published post id and URL. Pass original_text when the user edited a draft so BAMF learns from the edit.

in_reply_to.description: X post id or https://x.com/<handle>/status/<id> URL being replied to.

original_text.description: The AI draft before the user's edits, if edited.

target_author_handle.description: Handle of the post's author (for the per-author cap); parsed from the URL when omitted.

name: bamf.publish_x_reply
